args: Fix Women's Fashion image quality by reducing display size to avoid excessive upscaling. The source image is 143x191 pixels but currently displayed at 400x534 causing blur. In apps/web/components/onboarding/OnboardingDepartment.tsx: Change Image width from 400 to 286 and height from 534 to 382 (2x native resolution for retina displays). This prevents quality loss from upscaling a small source image. Also add 'quality={100}' prop to the Image component to ensure maximum quality.
